<b>Choir Elders</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are [[Elder Pilgrim]]s who have become part of [[the Choir]], positioning themselves above their enemies to crush them.<ref>Choir Elder [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Aged former pilgrim. Uses their wings to position above threats and crush them under their large shell."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Choir Elders either walk along the ground or start off lifeless and get reanimated with [[Silk]] as [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] approaches, and then take to the air. Their sole attack is to fly quickly above Hornet and slam into the ground. To counter, dash away just past the slam and follow up with a quick attack.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-threaded]] Choir Elders have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|Void attacks]].

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* There is no pain, nor fear, nor death...
* Am I worthy?
* The path... the holy path...
* My soul... my shell. For you!
* My faith... my reward...
* Raise me higher! Pull me closer!
* Lives end, journeys begin...
* Raise my shell! Pull me closer!
* Shining bright, our Citadel waits...
* Pull us higher, ever higher...
* We will climb! Climb! Climb forever!
}}

== Location ==
Choir Elders can be found in the [[Choral Chambers]].

One Choir Elder appears during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Whispering Vaults 1|enemy gauntlet]] at the entrance to the [[Whispering Vaults]], accessible from the [[Cogwork Core]].
